# vellum-ui

> A React component library with design tokens, light and dark modes, accent colors and density settings. Compose interfaces with semantic props and a shared theme.

Usage conventions:

- Import components, hooks and types from `vellum-ui` only. Do not import `antd`, `@ant-design/*` or `lucide-react` directly, even though the library uses them inside.
- Components accept no `style` or `className`; use their semantic props (`size` is `sm` / `md` / `lg`, semantic colors are `tone`, appearances are `variant`, spacing uses the steps `0`–`8`).
- The props are the library's own, not Ant Design's: for example `<Button variant="primary">`, `<Select multiple>`, Form.Item `status`. Read [conventions](docs/en-US/guides/conventions.md) before writing code.
- Text inputs (`Input`, `Input.Search`, `Input.Password`, `Input.TextArea`) call `onChange(event)`; read `event.target.value`. `Input.Search.onSearch(value)` receives a string. Value controls such as `Select` and `InputNumber` call `onChange(value)`; "no value" is `null`; dates and times are ISO strings; decimal amounts are strings. See each component page for its exact callback type.
- Wrap the application once in `ThemeProvider` (and `App` for `useMessage` / `useConfirmDanger`), and import `vellum-ui/styles.css` once; see the [README](README.md#usage).
- Every component page has the import, complete examples, the props (by mode when they differ, such as single and multiple selection), static members such as `Form.Item`, and the types used. The TypeScript declarations of the package carry the same descriptions.

Links are relative to this file. Installed documentation is available at `node_modules/vellum-ui/llms.txt` and matches the package version.

## Guides

- [Building pages](docs/en-US/guides/building-pages.md): Build consistent application pages with vellum-ui components and semantic props. This guide covers component selection, page layouts, interaction states and content formatting. For complete examples, see the [recipes](#recipes).
- [Conventions](docs/en-US/guides/conventions.md): vellum-ui defines its own public API, including for components implemented with Ant Design. This guide describes shared prop names, value formats, callbacks, accessibility attributes and localization, with an Ant Design comparison for common APIs.
- [Custom styles](docs/en-US/guides/custom-styles.md): Use custom CSS for product-specific visuals that existing components do not cover. Follow the library's design tokens, interaction states and motion conventions to keep these visuals consistent with the active theme.

## Recipes

- [Chat page](docs/en-US/recipes/ChatPage.md): A full-screen chat without Page: a flush SplitView with the conversations on the left, and a MessageList with PromptInput on the right.
- [Dashboard](docs/en-US/recipes/Dashboard.md): A Page with a time range in the toolbar, a row of Statistic tiles in a Grid, and charts below: a LineChart, a BarChart, a DonutChart and a SegmentedBar.
- [Detail page](docs/en-US/recipes/DetailPage.md): The title and actions of one record, with a "More" menu; its fields in Descriptions, a meter in a Panel, and Tabs whose content loads on its own.
- [Form dialog](docs/en-US/recipes/FormDialog.md): A primary action opens a Modal with a Form: required fields, an email rule, an asynchronous check, a date and a hint.
- [List page](docs/en-US/recipes/ListPage.md): A page with a title, a primary action, a search and a filter in the toolbar, and a DataTable with pagination, selection and bulk actions; loading, empty and error states.
- [Master-detail page](docs/en-US/recipes/MasterDetail.md): A SplitView: a searchable list of ListItem on the left, the details of the selected item on the right, each side scrolling on its own.
- [Settings page](docs/en-US/recipes/SettingsPage.md): A narrow page of Sections and Panels with SettingRow: switches that take effect immediately (and roll back when saving fails), and a group of InputNumber and Select saved with one button, with a message as feedback; a danger zone at the end.

## Components

### Primitives

- [Box](docs/en-US/components/Box.md): A general-purpose container whose padding, surface, radius and border all come from tokens.
- [Center](docs/en-US/components/Center.md): Centers its content horizontally and vertically in the available space.
- [Divider](docs/en-US/components/Divider.md): A divider that separates content at the same level, optionally with text (such as date separators in a message list).
- [Grid](docs/en-US/components/Grid.md): Arranges children in a grid, with a fixed number of columns or filled automatically by a minimum column width.
- [Inline](docs/en-US/components/Inline.md): Lays out children horizontally, vertically centered by default.
- [Spacer](docs/en-US/components/Spacer.md): Flexible space that fills the remaining space in an Inline or Stack and pushes the following elements to the other end.
- [Stack](docs/en-US/components/Stack.md): Lays out children vertically, with spacing from the token steps.
- [Text](docs/en-US/components/Text.md): Text with consistent font size, weight, tone, monospace and truncation.

### Basic

- [AutoComplete](docs/en-US/components/AutoComplete.md): AutoComplete is a text input that suggests values while typing; unlike Select, any text can be entered.
- [Avatar](docs/en-US/components/Avatar.md): A letter avatar showing the first character of a name.
- [Breadcrumb](docs/en-US/components/Breadcrumb.md): Breadcrumb shows where the current page is in the hierarchy and links to its parent pages.
- [Button](docs/en-US/components/Button.md): Buttons trigger an action.
- [Cascader](docs/en-US/components/Cascader.md): Cascader picks a value from options nested in several levels, such as region → city → district or category → subcategory; each level opens in its own column.
- [Checkbox](docs/en-US/components/Checkbox.md): Checkbox for multiple choices, or a single yes/no choice such as "Also delete the data".
- [ColorPicker](docs/en-US/components/ColorPicker.md): ColorPicker picks a color in a panel (saturation area, hue and alpha, a text field in HEX, RGB or HSB) and shows it in a swatch; `presets` offers a set of colors to pick from, and `showText` shows the value next to the swatch.
- [ContextMenu](docs/en-US/components/ContextMenu.md): A context menu: wraps any content and opens a menu of actions on right click, `Shift+F10` or the menu key, at the pointer or next to the focused element.
- [CopyButton](docs/en-US/components/CopyButton.md): A button that copies a text to the clipboard.
- [CountBadge](docs/en-US/components/CountBadge.md): A count badge: a pill with tabular numbers.
- [DatePicker](docs/en-US/components/DatePicker.md): Date picker: picks a date (with a time when `showTime` is set, or a month with `picker="month"`).
- [Dropdown](docs/en-US/components/Dropdown.md): Dropdown menu: a list of actions (`menu.items`) that opens when the trigger is clicked or hovered.
- [Form](docs/en-US/components/Form.md): Collects, validates and submits data.
- [Heading](docs/en-US/components/Heading.md): A heading whose font, weight and letter spacing come from tokens.
- [Icon](docs/en-US/components/Icon.md): A line icon (Lucide), referenced by name, with a consistent stroke width.
- [IconButton](docs/en-US/components/IconButton.md): A square icon button with a transparent background, a tooltip and an accessible name.
- [Input](docs/en-US/components/Input.md): Single-line text input.
- [InputNumber](docs/en-US/components/InputNumber.md): Numeric input with step buttons and tabular numbers.
- [Kbd](docs/en-US/components/Kbd.md): Key caps that show a keyboard shortcut, such as `<Kbd keys={['Mod', 'K']} />`: ⌘ K on macOS, Ctrl K on other platforms.
- [LinkButton](docs/en-US/components/LinkButton.md): A text link button: accent-colored text without background or underline, with the font size of its context.
- [ListItem](docs/en-US/components/ListItem.md): A list item with an avatar or icon on the left, a title and description in the middle, and time and actions on the right; it fills on hover, highlights when selected and works with the keyboard.
- [Pill](docs/en-US/components/Pill.md): A status pill: a subtle background with text in the same hue, optionally with a status dot.
- [Radio](docs/en-US/components/Radio.md): Radio buttons choose one of a few mutually exclusive options when all of them should stay visible (use Select when there are many).
- [Segmented](docs/en-US/components/Segmented.md): Segmented control: switches between two to five mutually exclusive options, with an indicator that slides between them.
- [Select](docs/en-US/components/Select.md): Selects one or several (`multiple`) values from a list of options; add `showSearch` when there are many options.
- [SettingRow](docs/en-US/components/SettingRow.md): A setting row with a name and description on the left and a control on the right.
- [Slider](docs/en-US/components/Slider.md): Slider picks a number, or a range with `range`, by dragging a handle along a track.
- [StatusDot](docs/en-US/components/StatusDot.md): A status dot that shows a status with a semantic color.
- [Steps](docs/en-US/components/Steps.md): Steps show where the user is in a task of several steps.
- [Switch](docs/en-US/components/Switch.md): Switch for an on/off setting that takes effect immediately.
- [Tabs](docs/en-US/components/Tabs.md): Tabs switch between several groups of sibling content in the same area, with the selection underline sliding between tabs.
- [TimePicker](docs/en-US/components/TimePicker.md): Time picker: picks a time of day in columns of hours, minutes and seconds; `format` without seconds (`HH:mm`) hides the seconds and the value has none either.
- [Tooltip](docs/en-US/components/Tooltip.md): Tooltip: a short explanation shown on hover or focus.
- [TreeSelect](docs/en-US/components/TreeSelect.md): Selects nodes from hierarchical data such as teams or folders.
- [Upload](docs/en-US/components/Upload.md): Chooses files and shows them in a list with their progress.

### Data

- [CodeBlock](docs/en-US/components/CodeBlock.md): A code block in a monospace font that keeps line breaks and indentation and scrolls inside the block when the content overflows.
- [DataTable](docs/en-US/components/DataTable.md): A data table with sorting, selection, pinned and resizable columns, column settings saved on this device, and virtual scrolling for large data.
- [Descriptions](docs/en-US/components/Descriptions.md): A description list that shows groups of read-only "label: value" fields aligned in columns.
- [InlineEdit](docs/en-US/components/InlineEdit.md): Edits a simple field in place, in lists, table cells and details, without opening a form: a text, a localized number or a choice from options.
- [Pagination](docs/en-US/components/Pagination.md): Pagination moves between pages of data.
- [Timeline](docs/en-US/components/Timeline.md): A timeline that shows events in chronological order.
- [Tree](docs/en-US/components/Tree.md): A tree that shows hierarchical data, with expanding, selecting, checking and drag-to-reorder.
- [VirtualList](docs/en-US/components/VirtualList.md): Virtualized list with variable row heights: a long list renders only its visible part, and scrolling to the end can load more.

### Charts

- [AreaChart](docs/en-US/components/AreaChart.md): Area chart: a line chart whose areas are filled with a light wash (about 10% opacity).
- [BarChart](docs/en-US/components/BarChart.md): Bar chart: compares values across categories, as grouped or stacked columns, or as horizontal bars.
- [ChartContainer](docs/en-US/components/ChartContainer.md): A card for a chart: title, description, actions, legend, the graphic and its states.
- [DonutChart](docs/en-US/components/DonutChart.md): Donut chart: a pie chart drawn as a ring.
- [Heatmap](docs/en-US/components/Heatmap.md): Heatmap: values over two sets of categories (such as weekdays and hours), colored on a sequential scale for magnitude or a diverging scale around a midpoint.
- [LineChart](docs/en-US/components/LineChart.md): Line chart: one or more series over ordered categories, usually time.
- [PieChart](docs/en-US/components/PieChart.md): Pie chart: one whole split into a few parts (at most 6 by default; the rest is folded into "Other").
- [ScatterChart](docs/en-US/components/ScatterChart.md): Scatter chart: the relation between two values, one point per item.
- [SegmentedBar](docs/en-US/components/SegmentedBar.md): A segmented bar shows how one whole splits into a few parts (up to 6 by default), as blocks whose widths are proportional to the amounts.
- [Sparkline](docs/en-US/components/Sparkline.md): A sparkline: a small trend line without axes, for stat tiles and table cells.
- [Statistic](docs/en-US/components/Statistic.md): A stat tile: a label, a value, its change compared with an earlier period, and an optional trend line.

### AI

- [Citation](docs/en-US/components/Citation.md): An inline citation marker, such as a superscript 1 after a sentence, that shows its source on hover or focus.
- [Markdown](docs/en-US/components/Markdown.md): Renders Markdown written by an AI, also while it streams in.
- [Message](docs/en-US/components/Message.md): One message of a conversation.
- [MessageActions](docs/en-US/components/MessageActions.md): Actions under a message: copy, retry, like and dislike, plus your own icon buttons.
- [MessageList](docs/en-US/components/MessageList.md): A virtualized list of messages that stays at the latest message: only the visible messages are rendered (the number of DOM nodes does not depend on the number of messages, and heights can vary), and new messages or a reply that is still growing keep the view at the end.
- [PromptInput](docs/en-US/components/PromptInput.md): The text field of a chat: it grows with its text, sends with `Enter` and turns its send button into a stop button while a reply is generated.
- [PromptSuggestions](docs/en-US/components/PromptSuggestions.md): A set of suggested prompts, each with a label and an optional description and icon; choosing one calls `onSelect`.
- [Reasoning](docs/en-US/components/Reasoning.md): The reasoning of an AI model before its answer: a header that shows whether it is still thinking or how long it took, and the reasoning text, which can be expanded and collapsed.
- [Sources](docs/en-US/components/Sources.md): The sources of an AI reply: collapsed to "3 sources" at first, and a numbered list with the title, the site and a short description of each when expanded.
- [StreamingText](docs/en-US/components/StreamingText.md): Plain text that is typed out while it streams in: new text is revealed at a steady pace that follows the arrival of the chunks, instead of appearing in blocks.
- [ToolCalls](docs/en-US/components/ToolCalls.md): A list of tool calls or steps of an AI agent, each with its state, and its input and output that can be expanded.
- [useStream](docs/en-US/components/useStream.md): Runs a streaming request and accumulates its chunks into a value, such as the text of an AI reply.

### Feedback

- [Alert](docs/en-US/components/Alert.md): An alert for persistent information on a page or in an area that needs the user's attention (warnings, limits, next steps); `tone` sets the meaning.
- [App](docs/en-US/components/App.md): Root component of the application: provides the context for messages (useMessage) and danger confirmations (useConfirmDanger), so that they use the current theme.
- [Drawer](docs/en-US/components/Drawer.md): Drawer that slides in from the right, for viewing details or editing longer content without leaving the current page.
- [EmptyState](docs/en-US/components/EmptyState.md): Empty state: an icon or illustration, an explanation and a call to action.
- [ErrorState](docs/en-US/components/ErrorState.md): Error state: shown instead of the content when loading fails, with the reason and a way to retry.
- [Loading](docs/en-US/components/Loading.md): Loading indicator: a centered spinner.
- [Modal](docs/en-US/components/Modal.md): Dialog for a short task that needs the user's full attention (create, edit, confirm).
- [PageSkeleton](docs/en-US/components/PageSkeleton.md): Page skeleton: replaces the whole page while its data loads for the first time; its shape is close to the final page, which reduces layout shifts.
- [Popconfirm](docs/en-US/components/Popconfirm.md): Popconfirm: a lightweight confirmation that pops up next to its trigger, for actions with a small impact that still need confirming (such as removing one access grant).
- [Popover](docs/en-US/components/Popover.md): Popover: a floating card next to its trigger with a title and richer content than a tooltip, such as details of a person, a short form or a few actions.
- [Progress](docs/en-US/components/Progress.md): Progress shows how far a task has come, as a line (default) or a ring (`variant="circle"`); the value uses tabular numbers.
- [Skeleton](docs/en-US/components/Skeleton.md): A skeleton: a placeholder shaped like the final content while part of the page loads.
- [useConfirmDanger](docs/en-US/components/useConfirmDanger.md): Danger confirmation: returns `confirm(options)`, which resolves to true when the user confirms.
- [useMessage](docs/en-US/components/useMessage.md): Messages: short notices about the result of an action; choose `success`, `error`, `info`, `warning` or `loading` by meaning, and use `undoable` to offer "Undo" for reversible actions.

### Patterns

- [AppShell](docs/en-US/components/AppShell.md): The frame of an application: a top bar, a sidebar (usually a Nav) and the main area.
- [CommandPalette](docs/en-US/components/CommandPalette.md): A command palette: a search field with a list of pages and actions to jump to or run, usually opened with `Mod+K` (register it with useHotkeys).
- [Nav](docs/en-US/components/Nav.md): Vertical navigation for the sidebar of an application: items with an icon, a label and a count, in groups with headings; the current page is selected.
- [Page](docs/en-US/components/Page.md): Page layout: page header (title, description, actions, an optional back action), toolbar and content, with consistent spacing, maximum width and entrance motion.
- [PageHeader](docs/en-US/components/PageHeader.md): Page header: title, description and actions on the right, with an optional back action before the title.
- [Panel](docs/en-US/components/Panel.md): Panel: a rounded surface (with a very faint contact shadow in light mode and no border), optionally with a title row.
- [Section](docs/en-US/components/Section.md): Section: a group of content with a title and a description, dividing pages, panels and drawers into parts.
- [SelectionBar](docs/en-US/components/SelectionBar.md): A bar for bulk actions on selected items: it shows how many are selected, a clear button, "Select all N" and your actions, and replaces the toolbar in place while anything is selected.
- [Splitter](docs/en-US/components/Splitter.md): A resizable split between two panes: drag the handle, or focus it and use the keyboard.
- [SplitView](docs/en-US/components/SplitView.md): Split view: choose in the narrow column on the left, see the details on the right; each side scrolls on its own.
- [Toolbar](docs/en-US/components/Toolbar.md): Toolbar with filters and search on the left and actions on the right, wrapping when space runs out.
- [useHotkeys](docs/en-US/components/useHotkeys.md): Registers a keyboard shortcut for as long as the component is mounted, such as `useHotkeys('mod+k', openPalette, { description: 'Search' })`.

### Media

- [Image](docs/en-US/components/Image.md): Image with a placeholder while loading, a fallback when loading fails, and a larger preview on click.
- [ImageGrid](docs/en-US/components/ImageGrid.md): Virtualized media grid: shows images or other items as a grid of thumbnails; even with tens of thousands of items only the visible part is rendered, and tiles can be selected with the keyboard.
- [Lightbox](docs/en-US/components/Lightbox.md): Full-screen image viewer (lightbox) on a neutral background (the viewer background tokens, which do not follow the theme by default); `Esc` closes it and `←` / `→` switch images.

## API reference

- [Theme](docs/en-US/api/theme.md): `CSS_VAR_PREFIX`, `compileTheme`, `cssVar`, `extendTheme`, `resolveTheme`, `toCssText`, `ThemeProvider`, `useTheme`, `builtinThemes`, `DEFAULT_THEME_ID`, `defaultTheme`, `componentTokens`, `primitives`, `defaultScale`, `fontStacks`, `viewerStages`, `viewerStageTokens`
- [Colors](docs/en-US/api/colors.md): `contrastRatio`, `deriveStates`, `formatOklch`, `oklch`, `relativeLuminance`, `toHex`, `CHART_CATEGORICAL_COUNT`, `CHART_RAMP_STEPS`
- [Localization](docs/en-US/api/i18n.md): `builtinMessages`, `enUS`, `formatMessage`, `useT`, `zhCN`, `LocaleProvider`
- [Keyboard shortcuts](docs/en-US/api/hotkeys.md): `HotkeysProvider`, `useRegisteredHotkeys`
- [Streaming](docs/en-US/api/streaming.md): `readSSE`, `readTextStream`, `StreamResponseError`
- [Utilities](docs/en-US/api/utilities.md): `matchCommands`, `iconNames`, `isIconName`, `useDelayedPending`
